How your message is handled

Your name, email, and message are shared with the team. A necessary cookie limits messages to three per hour, with additional spam protection. An unsent draft is kept in this tab’s session for up to four hours so you can return to it. It is removed when sent or discarded; closing the tab normally ends the session. Nothing is saved to long-term local storage.
